briefTitle: A Study to Evaluate KIN-2787 in Participants With BRAF and/or NRAS Mutation Positive Solid Tumors

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Metastatic or advanced stage solid tumor
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The trial enrolls solid tumors generally with metastatic or advanced stage and does not give a numbered stage list for NSCLC specifically.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable (Part A and B) or evaluable (Part A only) disease by RECIST v1.1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate organ function, as measured by laboratory values (criteria listed in protocol).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Specific lab thresholds are not explicitly stated in the eligibility text.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known participants who have received local therapy with either surgery and/or radiation therapy (participants with asymptomatic untreated brain metastasis may be eligible if met with certain criteria)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Brain metastases and local therapy criteria involve conditional exceptions and are not a clean typed brain_mets check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: In Part B Dose Expansion, previous treatment with any approved or in-development small molecule BRAF-, MEK-, or MAPK-directed inhibitor therapy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy exclusion applies only to Part B and includes broad class inhibitors.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: minimumAge: 18 Years
